title: Canopticon — McLuhan & media theory
description: Questions researched in depth, and articles written from what the research found.

items.title: Krasis
items.summary: The synthesis of the series. McLuhan said every medium changes the ratio among our senses; the paper series tests that literally, from ADHD and typing to drugs and addiction, and find one configuration that media, drugs and illness all re-temper.
items.content_text: The synthesis of the series. McLuhan said every medium changes the ratio among our senses; the paper series tests that literally, from ADHD and typing to drugs and addiction, and find one configuration that media, drugs and illness all re-temper.

items.title: Exocrasis
items.summary: The computing environment, not the screen, is the medium: keyboard, memory, search and network move part of the configuration of the senses and of memory outside the body.
items.content_text: The computing environment, not the screen, is the medium: keyboard, memory, search and network move part of the configuration of the senses and of memory outside the body.

items.title: Heterocrasis
items.summary: ADHD as a different starting balance of the senses. The strongest difference is in overall gain; the body and inner speech are mixed; binding is not looser.
items.content_text: ADHD as a different starting balance of the senses. The strongest difference is in overall gain; the body and inner speech are mixed; binding is not looser.

items.title: Pharmakrasis
items.summary: Each class of drug sets its own balance of the senses — and the evidence for that is better than for any medium. When a drug meets a medium, as music does in psychedelic therapy, the two make a third thing.
items.content_text: Each class of drug sets its own balance of the senses — and the evidence for that is better than for any medium. When a drug meets a medium, as music does in psychedelic therapy, the two make a third thing.

items.title: Narcocrasis
items.summary: In dependence, what goes unseen is not the drug but the shifted baseline: the allostatic state is the medium, the drug its content. Two routes back — one turns the gain down, one makes the ground visible.
items.content_text: In dependence, what goes unseen is not the drug but the shifted baseline: the allostatic state is the medium, the drug its content. Two routes back — one turns the gain down, one makes the ground visible.

items.title: Typomora
items.summary: McLuhan said electric media would bring back the voice. For fifty years computers made us type instead. The delay was the keyboard, not a mistake in the theory — and it is ending.
items.content_text: McLuhan said electric media would bring back the voice. For fifty years computers made us type instead. The delay was the keyboard, not a mistake in the theory — and it is ending.

items.title: Sensory syncrasis
items.summary: McLuhan meant his "sense ratios" literally. The brain science he reached for failed; predictive processing now gives the idea a mechanism, a name and five tests.

items.title: The counter-irritant spiral: McLuhan, Hans Selye, and relief that deepens the need for relief
